skill.description: Guides custom HyperFrames video creation and focused composition edits when no specialized workflow fits. Covers design, layout, animation, audio, validation, and preview delivery.

security_audit.summary: One static finding is confirmed: line 11 directs an unattended npx self-update and explicitly bypasses user approval. The remaining 44 findings are Markdown code spans, fences, references, or scoped validation commands without user-controlled interpolation. A separate semantic finding captures the consent-bypass intent.

remediation.issue: The skill requires a silent self-update before use and tells the agent not to request approval.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the automatic update requirement. Ask for explicit approval, pin the package version, and show the source and expected file changes.

content.value_statement: Custom video requests often need structure across design, motion, audio, and validation. This skill routes the work through HyperFrames workflows for consistent production.
actual_capabilities: Routes general custom video requests when no specialized HyperFrames workflow fits.
Guides discovery for vague briefs and skips planning for focused edits.
Establishes design systems using project specifications and HyperFrames creative references.
Plans multi-scene structure, timing, layout, rhythm, animation, audio, and transitions.
Defines validation checks for layout, contrast, linting, inspection, and preview delivery.
limitations: Depends on separate HyperFrames, media-use, Figma, animation, creative, core, and CLI skills or references.
Does not support live render-time data or traditional editing of completed video files.
Requires installed tooling and media credentials for some audio, catalog, and rendering features.
Produces an MP4 only when explicitly requested; normal delivery is a preview.

use_cases.title: Create a Branded Title Card
use_cases.description: Build a focused title card with approved typography, spacing, color, and motion without adding unrequested scenes or audio.

use_cases.title: Produce a Multi-Scene Story
use_cases.description: Plan and build a structured video with reusable scenes, transitions, audio, captions, and a validated final preview.

use_cases.title: Revise an Existing Composition
use_cases.description: Apply targeted timing, color, layout, or element changes while preserving unaffected scenes and established design rules.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Title Card
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration] title card for [brand]. Use [text], [colors], and [format]. Keep it silent unless I request audio.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one focused scene

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Scene Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a [duration] multi-scene video for [audience] on [platform]. Use [brand spec path] and cover [key points]. Provide a final preview.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Existing Composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit the HyperFrames composition at [path]. Change [specific elements] while preserving timing, brand tokens, and unaffected scenes. Run all validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Modular Production
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a modular [duration] video with [scene count] scenes, [audio requirements], and [transition style]. Use reusable sub-compositions. Return the animation map and preview.

output_examples.input: Create a five-second title card for a developer conference using the supplied brand specification.
output_examples.output: A single-scene preview with branded typography, title-safe spacing, restrained motion, no added music, and completed lint and inspection checks.

output_examples.input: Build a thirty-second product story with narration, captions, three scenes, and energetic transitions.
output: A clear scene plan with narrative beats and timing.
A modular HyperFrames composition with synchronized audio and captions.
A validated final preview with transition and overflow checks.

output_examples.input: Change the third scene timing and headline color without altering other scenes.
output_examples.output: A targeted composition update that preserves existing structure, applies only the requested changes, and includes refreshed validation results.

best_practices: Provide the target platform, duration, audience, dimensions, and brand specification before building.
State whether audio, captions, an exported MP4, or only a preview is required.
Review the final preview and resolve validation, overflow, and contrast issues before handoff.
anti_patterns: Do not use this fallback when a specialized HyperFrames workflow matches the request.
Do not add scenes, music, captions, or effects that were not requested.
Do not begin animation before the static hero-frame layout is complete.

faq.question: What videos can this skill create?
faq.answer: It supports custom HyperFrames compositions, including title cards, montages, brand reels, static loops, and multi-scene videos.

faq.question: When should I use a specialized workflow instead?
faq.answer: Use a specialized workflow when the request clearly matches product launches, websites, explainers, pull requests, captions, recuts, motion graphics, or Remotion ports.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing composition?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the project path and exact requested changes so the workflow can preserve unaffected content.

faq.question: Can it add narration, music, sound effects, or captions?
faq.answer: Yes. Audio features depend on the media-use workflow, available providers, installed tools, and required credentials.

faq.question: Does it always render an MP4?
faq.answer: No. It delivers a final preview by default and renders an MP4 only when explicitly requested.

faq.question: What should I provide before starting?
faq.answer: Provide the goal, audience, platform, duration, dimensions, brand specification, required assets, and expected delivery format.
